description: Annual chiller service — condenser cleaned, refrigerant topped up, oil analysis normal
VSD fault — replaced drive module, belt tension adjusted
Compressor oil change and filter replacement
UPS battery string test — 2 cells below threshold, flagged for replacement
Refrigerant leak on suction line — brazed and recharged 8kg R410A
Filter DP alarm — replaced all bag filters, found rodent nesting material
Mid-year service — condenser fouling noted (early stage), chemically cleaned
Generator load bank test 75% — passed, fuel filters replaced, battery charger checked
Damper actuator seized — replaced with Belimo LM24A-SR
High head pressure alarm — condenser fan motor bearing failure, replaced
Annual thermographic survey — hotspot on Phase B bus bar connection, retorqued
COP dropped below 3.0, condenser fouling advanced — full tube cleaning scheduled
2 battery cells replaced (flagged Jan), load test passed
Coil freeze protection tripped — faulty frost stat, replaced
Oil analysis shows elevated iron — bearing wear, monitor quarterly
Annual fire panel test — 3 detectors replaced, RS-485 bus intermittent on loop 2
Emergency call — chiller tripped on high head pressure, cannot restart. Condenser severely fouled despite Nov cleaning. Full mechanical clean required.
ATS transfer hesitation during load shedding — contactor contacts pitted, cleaned and tested
